# ADR 0002: Sealed rule hierarchy with exhaustive evaluation

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Mobile money fraud rules engine

## Context

Rules evolve often; a new rule type must be handled everywhere (evaluation, config, reporting).

## Decision

Model rules and verdicts as sealed interfaces of records; evaluate with pattern-matching switches.

## Consequences

Compiler-guided changes; explainable reason codes.

## Alternatives considered

Scripting-language rules (harder to test and secure).
